Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (15)
The one absolute ruler reigning over all dimensions.

To the Demon Army, Kelliark was such a being. That perfect being who surpassed all the order, laws, and authorities of the world they knew, who negated common sense, and who could not be brought down by any means, was now in need of support.
"Any further contempt towards Lord Kelliark will not be tolerated, Midor."

"And what will you do if you don't tolerate it? Your combat power is, after all, similar to mine. If Lord Kelliark stands up on his own and punishes me, I will accept it. I'll probably become a soul that can't even die. I'm not afraid of such things. What I fear is only that the man named Kelliark Zipple betrays my faith."
"You bastard!"
[What are you all chattering about? Is the fight that comfortable?]
Murakan was rushing towards Rondo. He had transformed into a human, keeping only his right arm in its dragon form, and was sweeping at Rondo's head.
The problem was that he had been momentarily shocked by Midor's attitude. Rondo didn't notice Murakan, who had suddenly closed the distance, in time.
The tip of a claw slashed Rondo's chest. He hastily put up a shield and pulled his body away, but his clavicle and sternum were caught on the claw that had dug in an inch.

The shield was actually a bad move. If Murakan's claw hadn't been caught on the shield, it would have been a clean cut. Like being struck by a rusty, chipped blade, a messy and deep wound was left on Rondo's chest.
"Keoheok."
If there was any silver lining, it was the fact that Midor hadn't completely betrayed him. Midor gritted his teeth as he created a space explosion to push Murakan away.
"Still, let's live and watch, Lord Rondo. To see if our leader truly collapses like this!"
It wasn't just Midor who thought that way.
All the Demon Army's Genesis Knights fighting alongside Rondo felt similarly. That if Kelliark couldn't stand up on his own, he was no longer worth following.

If Kelliark lost, they couldn't avoid death anyway. The path back to their homelands would be blocked, and there were even those whose home dimensions had already been destroyed by Malugia. There was no way the Vamel Alliance would forgive them either.
They had no choice but to fight to the end. Even if they could no longer trust Kelliark.
The spear fired from the Flame Orb once again cut through the dark sky and disappeared in vain. It was an unspeakably great power, but it kept missing.
[We must finish them off as soon as possible and support the battlefield!]
With Rondo seriously injured, the Demon Army no longer had the capacity to support Kelliark. Enduring the pressure from Murakan, the superhumans, and the fleet was the best they could do.

Even excluding Rondo, with five unharmed Genesis Knights, gods, and the Holy Kingdom knights, they were an unspeakably strong force. But the Vamel Alliance had united people and built a fleet precisely to defeat such foes.
[The enemy's spear is continuously dulling, so Lafrarosa will also begin to provide support soon. 1st Fleet, proceed to the crucible first.]
At Leuth's command, the flagship Sarah increased its power.
Tess was annihilated, but Jin's Blue Flame was not extinguished. The flagship Sarah was seen drawing its blazing blue blade and rushing towards the center of the battlefield.
Tzaaang-!
Sarah's blade fell upon the red shield Kelliark had spread. If it had been when he first appeared, Sarah wouldn't have even been able to approach like this.
But now, Kelliark was frowning and paying attention to Sarah.
"Such impertinent scrap metal...!"

Kiik, grrrrk! An unpleasant scraping sound vibrated from the blade and the shield. Kelliark tried to grab the blade with his magic and break it, but he turned his head upon suddenly noticing Vahn coming from the side.
Both were panting so heavily that it was impossible to say who was more tired. Vahn's sword was not as sharp as it originally was, and Kelliark's senses were the same.
The moment Vahn's sword pierced Kelliark's neck, the shield collapsed and Sarah also entered.
"Kah-haak!"

Kelliark's eyes glared. He grabbed Sarah as if throwing a person and let out a monstrous scream. He tried to use the ship's hull as a shield to block Vahn's sword, but Chiron and Araxion had also closed the distance with him.
Flesh and blood splattered. It would be fine if he regenerated, though it was slower, but the Genesis Knights were paying attention to his reaction.
'He's trying to avoid the attacks as much as possible.'
All this time, Kelliark had employed a style of fighting where he would deliberately allow attacks if it could create an opening in his opponent.

The fact that he had started to pay more attention to evasion must be because his regenerative power had finally reached its limit. The life force, whose end even he himself did not know, was now truly showing its bottom.
He unknowingly shifted his gaze for a moment to the center of the battlefield.
'...Am I... paying attention to them? Am I feeling frustrated, wondering why they can't tie down the flying fortress?'

Perhaps it was because his head had been blown off and regenerated too many times by the offensive of the Coalition and the immortals, but Kelliark was mistaking what Midor had said about him about ten minutes ago as something that had just happened.
'Midor, you son of a bitch. You're right... If I fall, laugh and spit on me as much as you want. You have that right. Though I doubt you'll survive the enemy's offensive.'
When he moved his endlessly heavy legs, all the bones in his body rattled. His vision flickered like a blinking light, and his magic was unruly like a raging torrent.
To have reached this state, there had been many mistakes.
Suddenly, Kelliark felt that he was not much different from the many fools in history who believed they had seized 'absolute power'.
'Arrogant because I am strong, complacent because I fear nothing, and bored because I have the whole world. Those idiots that are bound to exist in history... in truth, I was the same as them.'
To change the unchangeable.
To have the power to twist even that which never changes in any world, at any time.
Kelliark had believed that this was the only desire he had left. Conquering all dimensions and resurrecting the Sun God were merely processes for that.
But now, Kelliark was realizing.
'I should have been different from those common fools from the start. Because I wasn't, I can't escape this sorry state now.'
I want to live.
I want to enjoy. I want to change history as I wish, move time, and shape the world. A desire more intense than ever before was stimulating Kelliark's inner self.
And that desire was not just stirring within his inner self.
'What is this now...!?'
Suddenly, an unpleasant and viscous liquid was filling up the ground of the battlefield.
It was a liquid that shone red like congealed blood. It was clearly a change initiated by Kelliark, but it was not magic, nor was it blood.
Desire.
Just as martial artists who have reached a certain state form swords with their will alone and emit a sword energy that can split even mountains in a single blow.
Kelliark was materializing his desire. He was substantiating his inner emotions.
Before even five seconds had passed, the liquid had already covered the entire battlefield and was on the verge of advancing towards the far end of the Black Sea.
Valeria let out a dry heave as she saw all the records in the recording window being covered by the same sentence.
"Valeria!"
"Valeria?"
Even at Jin and Enya's calls, Valeria couldn't respond for a while, as if she was having trouble maintaining her consciousness.
As a guardian of records, as one who could 'read' history, she was instinctively aware of the consequences this desire would bring.
"Get a grip!"
"This, this record, this shouldn't be left in the world, I can't erase it... We have to finish that monster quickly."
"What do you mean?"

"Listen carefully, Jin. This red liquid is the materialization of Kelliark's desire, and it will spread throughout the whole world before today is over. The land that becomes so can never be restored. It's to the point where it can swallow even the Authority of Regeneration you possess."
"Desire...? This is?"

Looking around, it was just as she said. The red liquid was already covering and making all the golden energy left by Jin and his comrades disappear. Even though it was a light that had not been erased by Helluram's darkness or Malugia's sun energy.
The desire swells.

The desire, which had only been soaking their ankles just a few seconds ago, was now about to reach their knees. The Genesis Knights and the immortals were also seeking higher ground to avoid it and attacking Kelliark.
However, Malugia rose into the sky and just looked down at the spreading red liquid. With a face as dumbfounded as a human's.
"Malugia, you have failed in the end!"
Kelliark burst into laughter as he looked up at Malugia.
"Now, no matter what destruction you achieve, you will not be able to erase this red mark. An end that can simply be called nihilism can no longer be realized."
A trace of desire that will never be erased even if all dimensions meet their end.
Kelliark accurately grasped the nature of the red liquid and lumps pouring out from himself.

Even with hundreds of millions, billions of sword winds and exploding lightning energy, the red desire only seemed to disappear for a moment, then was seen to instantly fill that spot again. Just seeing that phenomenon felt like a part of one's mind was going distant.
A bizarre impulse, as if one should respect and follow his desire, was stirring in their minds.
"So now, the reason for you to fight, the reason for you to exist, has disappeared. You wouldn't want to run amok seeking revenge like mortals... Come to me. I will make you comfortable."
Malugia did not answer. Neither did Haylin, who was standing next to her. Soon, they were seen falling to the ground like dolls whose strings had been cut.
Before the two beings fell into the red sea of desire, it was Helluram who saved them. Helluram looked down at Kelliark, holding the two, who had stiffened like stone, in her arms.
[You have finally broken the world, orphan...]
At those words, Kelliark's eyes shone as he replied.
"This is only the beginning, witch. Do you feel it? The Origin Stone that you worked so hard to damage has just arrived here."
